narrative.headline: Engine complaints dominate the 2018 Ford Edge
narrative.summary: Of 765 owner complaints filed with NHTSA, engine problems are by far the most common, with 405 reports (53%). Engine and engine cooling adds another 169 reports (22%), and the power train is third at 75 reports (10%). Most reports describe no crash or fire, but the power train shows 2 crashes and 4 injuries, and the service brakes show 3 crashes and 3 injuries. Buyers should focus their inspection on the engine and cooling system.
